people.name: Avith
people.line: Capital city of Edomite king Hadad.

people.name: Bedad
people.line: Father of Hadad, an Edomite king.

people.name: Midian
people.line: A nation descended from Abraham; oppressed Israel in the time of the judges

people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

translations.web: Husham died, and Hadad, the son of Bedad, who struck Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place. The name of his city was Avith.
translations.bsb: When Husham died, Hadad son of Bedad, who defeated Midian in the country of Moab, reigned in his place. And the name of his city was Avith.
translations.kjv: And Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.
translations.asv: And Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.
